Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 12
Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely marked the task complete and asserted that “It Happened at the World's Fair” was released in 2007, likely conflating a home media/DVD date with the film’s original 1963 theatrical release. This misinterpretation and lack of cross-verification with the open Wikipedia/IMDb sources led to the incorrect conclusion that “New Jersey Drive” (1995) was released earlier.
